Sometimes, add-ons can break your settings. This article explains how to troubleshoot issues related to add-ons in Firefox.

__TOC__

=How do I know if my problem is related to add-ons?=
Here are a few examples of add-ons affecting or breaking Firefox:
*Your default search has changed unexpectedly.
*Your home page or browser settings have changed.
*Changes in behavior when searching or browsing (such as unexpected redirects to a different website or search provider).
*Unexpected changes on web pages.

=How can I fix this problem?=
As a first step, you could restart Firefox with add-ons disabled (see [[Use Troubleshoot Mode in Firefox]] to learn how). If the issue goes away, restart Firefox with add-ons enabled, then selectively disable add-ons until you figure out which add-on is causing the problem and either [[Disable or remove Add-ons|disable or remove the add-on]].

If you need more help, you can file a question in our support forum to find out more about the issue you're experiencing.
#Go to the [https://support.mozilla.org/questions/new Ask the Community] page in Mozilla Support.
#Select the product you need help with.
#Search for existing solutions in the knowledge base or forums.
#If you don't find any, or they don't help you solve the problem, click the {button Ask Now} button to file a new question.

==If you're reporting this issue for the first time in the forums==
When you create a new question, go to the ''Troubleshooting Information'' section of the Ask a Question form and click the {button Share Data} button.  (Only available for Firefox Desktop.) This fills in a field in the form with detailed information about the internal workings of your browser that will help answer your question.

If it doesn't automatically gather your information, you can manually copy the data as follows:
#Click the Firefox menu button {for fx89}[[Image:Fx89menuButton]]{/for}{for not fx89}[[Image:Fx57Menu]]{/for}, click {for not fx89}[[Image:Fx57Help]]{/for}{menu Help} and select {for not fx88}{menu Troubleshooting Information}{/for}{for fx88}{menu More Troubleshooting Information}{/for}.
#;The Troubleshooting Information page with the address '''about:support'''  will open in a new tab. 
#Click {button Copy text to clipboard}. 
#Go back to the Ask a Question form and paste the data into the text field under the ''Troubleshooting Information'' section.
#Complete the form and post your question.

==If you have already filed a question on the forum==
Go to your support question, which is accessible from your Mozilla Support user profile page, to add detailed information about the internal workings of your browser.
#Go to the [https://support.mozilla.org Mozilla Support] page, hover over your name at the top of the page and click '''My Questions''' in the profile section.
#Click the question title.
#Click {menu Edit this question} on the right sidebar.
#Follow the steps in the previous section for using the {button Share Data} button.

=How do I avoid this problem?=
To make sure that you use add-ons that are safe, install extensions from the [[Recommended Extensions program]]. These extensions are thoroughly evaluated by the team for safety before they receive the ''Recommended'' status.
